# cloudtower_vm_placement_group (Resource)

CloudTower VM placement group resource. At least one host placement or VM affinity rule must be enabled. VM membership is managed from the `cloudtower_vm` resource through its `placement_group_ids` attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudtower_vm_placement_group" "database" {
  name        = "database"
  description = "Keep database VMs on dedicated hosts and spread them apart"
  cluster_id  = "cluster-id"

  required_host_rule {
    enabled   = true
    placement = "ON_SELECTED_HOSTS"
    host_ids = [
      "host-id-1",
      "host-id-2",
    ]
  }

  preferred_host_rule {
    enabled = false
  }

  vm_affinity {
    enabled     = true
    enforcement = "REQUIRED"
    placement   = "DIFFERENT_HOSTS"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The cluster ID of the VM placement group.
- `name` (String) The VM placement group name.
- `preferred_host_rule` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Preferred placement rule between VMs in this group and selected hosts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--preferred_host_rule))
- `required_host_rule` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Required placement rule between VMs in this group and selected hosts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--required_host_rule))
- `vm_affinity` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Placement rule between VMs in this group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vm_affinity))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The VM placement group description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the VM placement group is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The VM placement group ID.

<a id="nestedblock--preferred_host_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `preferred_host_rule`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the host placement rule is enabled.

Optional:

- `host_ids` (Set of String) Hosts selected by this rule. At least one host is required when the rule is enabled.
- `placement` (String) Whether VMs should run ON_SELECTED_HOSTS or OUTSIDE_SELECTED_HOSTS.


<a id="nestedblock--required_host_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `required_host_rule`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the host placement rule is enabled.

Optional:

- `host_ids` (Set of String) Hosts selected by this rule. At least one host is required when the rule is enabled.
- `placement` (String) Whether VMs should run ON_SELECTED_HOSTS or OUTSIDE_SELECTED_HOSTS.


<a id="nestedblock--vm_affinity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vm_affinity`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the VM affinity rule is enabled.

Optional:

- `enforcement` (String) Whether the VM affinity rule is REQUIRED or PREFERRED.
- `placement` (String) Whether VMs should run on the SAME_HOST or DIFFERENT_HOSTS.
